hil_001: You can recognise it by its leaves, cut deep into five narrow fingers, and bark flaking in olive and cream plates. It stands free on the east side of the pond at Landgoed Bantam.
hil_002: You can recognise it by the wrought iron fence around its base and the mushroom-shaped path marker, number 24591, beside it. It stands at the crossing of the Spanderslaan and the Oude Meentweg.
hil_006: You can recognise it by its bark, peeling in long fibrous strips, and drooping branch tips that turn up at the end. It stands in the southeast corner of Pinetum Blijdenstein.
hil_007: You can recognise it by its blue-grey needles in tight rosettes and branches leaving the trunk in flat horizontal tiers. It stands on the roadside at Soestdijkerstraatweg 11.
